description: Patent Design-Around & Freedom-to-Operate Architect — Paste patent claims or give a patent number. Splits the independent claims into lettered limitations in code, charts your product against each one (literal and doctrine of equivalents), scores claims under the all-elements rule, and proposes 3 engineering design-arounds that each remove a limitation of every independent claim, checked in code. Leads with a decision and optional dollar exposure. A

annualRevenueUsd.description: Annual revenue that depends on the product; sizes the dollar exposure in the headline.

assumedRoyaltyPct.description: Assumed running royalty as a percent of revenue, for the exposure illustration.

patentClaimsText.description: Numbered claims (at least the independent claims). Optional when patentNumber is given: the claims are then read from Google Patents.

patentNumber.description: Publication number such as US7629993B2. Used to read the claims from Google Patents when patentClaimsText is omitted.

name: patent-design-around
